feature: Default longitudinal strategy keeps the current speed
description: A car starts at 10 m/s with no cruise override on a 130 km/h road.

clauses: 7.4.1.1 Control strategy (default strategies: keep lane, keep current speed)
oracle.derivation: Only an Init SpeedAction is given, so the default strategy keeps 10 m/s: x=50+10t.

expect.note: Decision D-14: SimForge's default free-flow target is the lane limit (product behaviour); the OSC default keeps the current speed. The actions export refuses an omitted cruise target (P-7).
